last_handoff.revamp_mobile_pass_2026_07_25: M4-b MOBILE PASS DONE (founder reported mobile issues on the preview). Reviewed at real mobile viewports over CDP (320/360/390/430/768/1024px). ROOT CAUSE of most symptoms: the theme-B directional room reveals translate X by +/-46px, which on a phone pushes a full-width room past the screen edge and makes mobile Chrome WIDEN THE LAYOUT VIEWPORT (measured 417px on a 390px screen) -> sideways pan, position:fixed layers stretched (the guide dock's Reserve button fell off-screen), copy looked cropped. Sideways reveals now gated to >=960px (RoomsTrack's clamp(20px,5vw,64px) gutter only absorbs 46px at ~920px, so tablets overflowed too). Also fixed: Button max-sm:whitespace-normal (long ghost labels); PhoneFrame max-w-full + min-w-0 on its grid item (fixed px width + 10px chrome blew out a 320px room); /team bio column sm:min-w-[280px]; /stories art column w-[104px] sm:w-[130px] + p-5 sm:p-6; `p { text-wrap: pretty }` moved into @layer base (UNLAYERED CSS OUTRANKS EVERY TAILWIND UTILITY - it had been silently beating `truncate`, so the guide dock ran to 3 lines / 86px; now 1 line / 67px); CompareTable now STACKS one card per claim below sm (it was a 640px sideways scroll with 'Yes, up to 10' sliced mid-word and the three alternatives off-screen) while keeping the real table from sm up, both views reading one ROWS array with a test that they cannot disagree. VERIFIED 320/360/390/430px: 9/9 routes, no sideways pan, no stretched fixed layer; 1024px unchanged; tests 226/226, tsc clean, build green. Known 3px artifact at exactly 768px on Home (an .orbit-seat 2px past the edge; cannot pan, dock already hidden). NEW HARD RULES: never animate X on an element that spans the track width; base-level element rules in globals.css belong in @layer base. Full write-up: docs/qa-report.md 'Revamp M4-b'.
